Sandbox_ViewpointExtractionSupport.Night: At night, increase container item spawn chances and turn a configured percentage of zombies into sprinters. Disabled by default.
Percent added to each item's chance to spawn in containers. A 50%% bonus multiplies that chance by 1.5. Set to 0 to disable the loot bonus.
Each zombie has this percentage chance to become a sprinter at night. Their original speed returns during the day. Default: 10%%.
